Frequently asked questions

Helpful information

Can I request a quotation for multiple products?

Yes. Add the product names, required quantities and any specifications in the enquiry form. You can also attach or share a separate product list by email after contacting the team.

Can I enquire about an instrument not shown here?

Yes. Use the custom sourcing option in the contact form and describe the instrument or share its reference details.

Are product specifications and availability guaranteed?

Product images and descriptions are illustrative catalogue references. Confirm exact specifications, material, availability, regulatory documentation and order terms with the company before purchase.

Do you accept international enquiries?

International buyers and distributors are welcome to submit enquiries. Shipping options, export documentation and destination availability must be confirmed for each order.

How do I place an order?

Submit an Order Now or Get Quote enquiry. The team can confirm product details, price, availability and terms before you place a confirmed order.
